product.olivetti-m30030p.summary: 50 MHz i486DX2 performance variant of the M300-30, using a 25 MHz external bus.
product.olivetti-m30030p.history: The M300-30P is the fast variant of the M300-30: the same board and firmware, but with an i486DX2/50, which runs internally at 50 MHz on a 25 MHz bus.
product.olivetti-m30030p.technical.verif: With 4 MB, Diagnostics 2.00 completes all its tests and reports 640 KB base + 3072 KB extended + 384 KB dedicated = 4096 KB.
product.olivetti-m30030p.technical.limit: Partial bootable emulation, with the same chipset, video and Super I/O limits as the M300-30. The BIOS works out the CPU model from a board configuration register, reconstructed from the disassembly; it still has to be checked that Diagnostics 2.00 now shows it as DX2-50. Ctrl+Alt+Del can hang while the firmware restarts, so a hard reset is advisable for now. The other RAM configurations and more software remain pending.
product.olivetti-m30030p.technical.manua: Olivetti service guide chapter 36; primary source for M300-30 and M300-30P.
product.olivetti-m30030p.creation.storag: No hard disk: one 1.44 MB floppy drive
product.olivetti-m30030p.creation.model: M300-30P with an i486DX2/50, 4 MB, integrated WD90C31 and one 1.44 MB floppy drive
product.olivetti-m30030p.creation.note: If you add the disk, choose the type shown in the option in Setup. The three images carry the same OVC 1.09 video BIOS.
product.olivetti-m30030p.technical.cpu: Intel i486DX2/50: 50 MHz internally on a 25 MHz bus. VLSI VL82C486 chipset, combining the memory and AT-bus controller.
product.olivetti-m30030p.technical.memor: 4 to 36 MB (4, 8, 12, 20, 24 or 36 MB). With 4 MB, POST counts 640 KB base, 3072 KB extended and 384 KB dedicated: the 384 KB behind the hole between 640 KB and 1 MB are reserved for video and BIOS shadowing.
product.olivetti-m30030p.technical.video: Integrated Western Digital WD90C31 VGA with 1 MB. Its video BIOS, OVC 1.09, takes the lower half of the ROM.
product.olivetti-m30030p.technical.stora: PC87311/87312-family Super I/O (floppy, serial and parallel) and a buffered IDE interface. The BIOS table adds types 17 to 26 for IDE disks, including type 17 (805/4/26, 40 MB) and type 18 (776/8/33, 100 MB).
product.olivetti-m30030p.technical.firmw: Three 128 KB ROMs with the same OVC 1.09 video BIOS are preserved: Diagnostics 1.03 (09/24/92), 1.04 (11/05/92) and 2.00 (02/22/93). The BIOS reads the bus speed (25 or 33 MHz) and the Super I/O address from a board register, which it opens with keyboard-controller command 8Bh.
product.olivetti-m30030p.creation.cpu: Intel i486DX2-50: 50 MHz internally on a 25 MHz bus
